description_en: Changes the zone of a node from an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS MySQL集群系列实例节点可用区
name: MigrateDBNodes

parameters.help_en: Specifies the client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the IDs of instances
parameters.name: db_instance_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the zone in which the node resides
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The time when you want the system to start the migration. Valid value:

Immediately: The system immediately starts the migration. This is the default value.
MaintainTime: The system starts the migration during the specified maintenance window.
Specified: The system starts the migration at the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh:
迁移时间。取值：
Immediately：立即切换（默认）
MaintainTime：在运维时间段切换
ScheduleTime：在指定时间切换

如果传入ScheduleTime，则还需指定SwitchTime参数
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies the time when the modification is performed. We recommend that you apply the specification during off-peak hours. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 指定执行修改的时间。建议在业务低峰期执行变配。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: switch_time

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
表示请求是否成功，各取值含义如下：

true：成功
false：失败
